headline: NZ citizen returns home after losing son in Cox's Bazar boat tragedy
summary: John Edward Pudney spent 2.5 years building a wooden boat to sail the world with his family, but a tragic accident ended the dream.
details: John Edward Pudney, a New Zealand citizen, spent approximately two and a half years in Cox's Bazar building a custom wooden boat named 'Island Girl' to sail the world with his wife and two sons.
caption:
A dream of sailing the world ended in tragedy. A New Zealand father returns home after losing his 16-year-old son in Cox's Bazar.

John Edward Pudney, a New Zealand citizen, spent approximately two and a half years in Cox's Bazar building a custom wooden boat named 'Island Girl' to sail the world with his wife and two sons.

headline_marked: Bangladesh's [[first four-lane cycle track opens]] in Chattogram
headline: Bangladesh's first four-lane cycle track opens in Chattogram
summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury has inaugurated the 2.2km track on Airport Road, marking a shift toward eco-friendly urban mobility.
details: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury inaugurated the country's first four-lane cycle track on Friday in Chattogram's Patenga Airport Road.
The 2.2km track features dedicated lanes for cyclists, integrated with footpaths and a landscaping walkway, designed to encourage healthy and eco-friendly commuting.
Minister Chowdhury stated that the government aims to make cities more inclusive by providing dedicated spaces for those who love cycling and walking.
The Finance Minister urged local MPs to initiate similar projects in their respective areas and assured them of necessary government support.
Chattogram City Corporation Mayor Shahadat Hossain, who joined the Minister in cycling on the track, described the project as a symbol of progress toward a healthier urban life.
The track was developed as part of the 'Chattogram Airport Road Expansion and Other Physical Infrastructure Development' project.
Mayor Hossain emphasized that providing a safe environment will encourage the younger generation to use bicycles, which will help reduce traffic congestion and pollution.
caption:
Bangladesh just got its first dedicated cycle track! 🚲

Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury inaugurated the country's first four-lane cycle track on Friday in Chattogram's Patenga Airport Road.

The 2.2km track features dedicated lanes for cyclists, integrated with footpaths and a landscaping walkway, designed to encourage healthy and eco-friendly commuting.

Minister Chowdhury stated that the government aims to make cities more inclusive by providing dedicated spaces for those who love cycling and walking.

The Finance Minister urged local MPs to initiate similar projects in their respective areas and assured them of necessary government support.

Chattogram City Corporation Mayor Shahadat Hossain, who joined the Minister in cycling on the track, described the project as a symbol of progress toward a healthier urban life.

The track was developed as part of the 'Chattogram Airport Road Expansion and Other Physical Infrastructure Development' project.

Mayor Hossain emphasized that providing a safe environment will encourage the younger generation to use bicycles, which will help reduce traffic congestion and pollution.

#Bangladesh #Chattogram #Cycling #UrbanPlanning #EcoFriendly #News

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune
